gwt.given: a model type has a property decorated with a CollectionMapAttributeBase-derived attribute whose declared property type is not a recognized collection type (not ImmutableArray<T>, and does not implement IEnumerable<T>)
gwt.when: Mapper.HasCollectionMapProperties(modelType) (or any other Mapper operation that first resolves the model's collection-map properties) is called for that model type
gwt.then: the Mapper throws InvalidOperationException naming the offending property and the model type, instead of returning true or false
